_comment: Single source of truth for Cursor SQLite scan bounds. apps/macos/Seer/Sources/Detection/SessionSnapshotSource.swift, apps/macos/Seer/Sources/Detection/TurnAssessors.swift, and main/services/agent-detection-policy.ts (imported by main/services/agent-detector.ts) each hardcode these same values under their own naming convention; a parity test in each language asserts against this file so the two scanners can never silently drift apart.
